entry.description: OpenAI Math family 305, Four-dimensional disk embedding and Wall's conjecture. OpenAI's 6 October 2026 catalogue reports: The unrestricted four-dimensional disk-embedding conjecture fails: framed algebraic dual spheres do not suffice to obtain disjoint locally flat spanning disks. In particular, the free group F_2 is not good in the sense of Freedman–Quinn. Also constructs a finitely presented integral Poincaré duality group of dimension four with a finite classifying space but no realization as the fundamental group of a closed aspherical topological four-manifold, disproving Wall's conjecture. OpenAI says an internal frontier model produced the released result package; its repository warns that results have different verification statuses and that some unformalized results could have issues. OpenAI does not link a family-level Lean companion for the main result. This source-attributed record remains provisional=1. The release provides no family-level Lean link for the main result. Reconcile the catalogue summary with all 3 constituent manuscripts; reconstruct family-specific human/model generation, checking, and write-up roles; and monitor OpenAI's promised versioned corrections. entry.description: OpenAI Math family 307, Failure of rational injectivity for maximal coarse assembly. OpenAI's 6 October 2026 catalogue reports: Constructs a uniformly discrete bounded-geometry space whose maximal coarse assembly map is not rationally injective.
